description: This PHP class 'Dependent' extends ListableDisplayField and represents a report display field for dependents within the OrangeHRM system. It defines methods to return associated DTO class, entity aliases, and relevant database fields.

classes.name: Dependent
classes.description: A class representing a report display field for dependents within the OrangeHRM's reporting system, extending ListableDisplayField.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified class name of the DTO associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in the reporting query.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields associated with this display field.
